releases.notes:
## 📌 Mob Evolution Mod – Version 1.0.0 (Starting Point)
### 🌱 Core Features

- Custom Elite Hunter Zombie entity
- 30% shock effect on attack (Slowness II + Weakness, 3 sec)
- Basic spawn registration system
- Fabric API compatibility (1.20.1)
- Modular entity architecture prepared for future evolution stages

### 🧠 Gameplay Scope

- Simple evolution logic foundation
- Server-side effect handling
- Performance-safe attack override
- Basic monster scaling groundwork

### ⚠️ What is NOT Included Yet

- Boss phases
- Blood Moon events
- Player death adaptive scaling
- Advanced AI behavior tree
- Lore systems
- World difficulty persistence

### 🚀 Development Goal of This Version

👉 Establish stable entity framework
👉 Ensure zombie combat modifier works correctly
👉 Provide clean base for Stage Evolution System
